sections.title: Set the billing interval
sections.excerpt: Set the billing interval | Choose how often customers are billed (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) and the Every-X count for multi-period billing — for example every 3 months. This has to match the recurrence on the Stripe price you mapped, or Stripe will reject the checkout.

sections.title: Configure the free trial
sections.excerpt: Configure the free trial | Set how many free days a customer gets before the first charge; enter 0 for no trial. Billing starts the day after the trial ends. Always state the trial length clearly on the paywall — it keeps checkout compliant and cuts down on disputes and chargebacks from surprised customers.

sections.title: Charge an upfront fee at sign-up (optional)
sections.excerpt: Charge an upfront fee at sign-up (optional) | Turn this on to charge a one-time fee the moment the subscription starts, on top of the recurring price — useful for an activation or onboarding fee. Leave it off for a standard free-trial or pay-as-you-go subscription. (This is what the 'paid trial' setting controls: an immediate charge, not a free period.)

sections.title: Select the upfront fee price
sections.excerpt: Select the upfront fee price | Pick or create the one-time Stripe price used for that upfront fee. It's charged immediately and billed separately from the recurring subscription, so it shows up as its own line in Stripe.
